name: mahavira-born-jain-teacher
description: A prince of eastern India was born who would renounce wealth and become the last great teacher of Jainism.

name: tao-te-ching-written
description: A short book of eighty-one verses attributed to Laozi set out the Way, the foundation text of Taoism.

name: ashoka-converts-after-kalinga
description: Horrified by the carnage of conquering Kalinga, an Indian emperor turned to Buddhism and non-violence.

name: celestial-masters-founded
description: After a vision of the deified Laozi, a Sichuan healer founded the first organised Taoist religious movement.

name: kojiki-records-shinto-myths
description: Japan's oldest surviving book set down the creation myths and divine ancestry of the imperial line.

name: adi-shankara-born
description: The philosopher who would revive Hindu thought through non-dual Vedanta was born in Kerala.

name: nichiren-declares-teaching
description: A Japanese monk chanted devotion to the Lotus Sutra publicly for the first time, beginning a new Buddhist movement.

name: tsongkhapa-founds-ganden
description: A reforming scholar established the Tibetan monastery that anchored the Gelug school later led by the Dalai Lamas.

name: guru-nanak-born
description: The founder of Sikhism was born in the Punjab, the first of ten gurus and a teacher of one God.

name: dalai-lama-title-created
description: A Mongol ruler gave a Tibetan abbot the title Dalai, meaning ocean, founding a famous line of leaders.

name: guru-granth-sahib-compiled
description: The fifth Sikh guru gathered hymns of the gurus and other saints into the scripture installed at Amritsar.

name: shinto-buddhism-separation-order
description: A new government ordered gods and Buddhas separated in shrines, elevating Shinto and sparking attacks on temples.

name: vivekananda-chicago-address
description: A young Hindu monk opened with the words Sisters and Brothers of America and introduced Hindu thought to the West.

name: ambedkar-converts-to-buddhism
description: The architect of India's constitution led hundreds of thousands of followers from Hinduism to Buddhism at Nagpur.

name: hare-krishna-movement-founded
description: An Indian swami opened a small New York storefront and founded the society that brought Krishna chanting to Western streets.

name: beatles-study-meditation-india
description: The world's biggest band travelled to an ashram at Rishikesh to learn Transcendental Meditation from a guru.

name: dalai-lama-nobel-peace-prize
description: The exiled Tibetan Buddhist leader was honoured for his nonviolent approach to his people's struggle.

name: bamiyan-buddhas-destroyed
description: Two giant cliff-carved Buddha statues in Afghanistan were blown up by the ruling Taliban despite worldwide protest.
